newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were softer at the close, under pressure from a weaker tone in the Swiss franc late in the day.
The franc has lately soared to roughly 11-month highs against the German currency but eased back Thursday.

Traders said the Swiss Treasury's latest issue, a 13-year 3-1/2 percent bond, was well-received. In the auction which ended Thursday, a total of 561 million Swiss francs was allocated. The bond was priced at 97.65 to yield 3.731 percent.
The allocation was higher than some traders had expected.
"In general the mood is quite positive," one trader said.
Euro Swiss francs down five at 98.43.
